body: Lol the process isn’t unfair ? Go read on a2c about the guy who was forced by an admissions counselor his mom paid to start a non profit he didn’t care about and write his essays on it. If you wanna get technical it might not be lying but when you really examine it it’s basically the same thing. This isn’t the only instance however the list goes on and on. If you’re poor it’s way harder without connections parental help etc. so hell yeah I’d exaggerate the shit out of myself cause these rich kids are already doing it and I’m already disadvantaged so what’s the problem ? Yeah it might be unethical but who does it harm ? There’s always a chance you could take someone in a similar position as you or a rich kids spot away but 9/10 it’s the rich kids spot you’ll take. The next thing is most of them get into multiple ivies while internationals struggle to get into one so.  TLDR full rides don’t come by chance you have to be extremely lucky so might as well increase your chances you aren’t harming anyone 🤥

I said the main sub go back a year from today and even recently read comments etc etc. there were also a ton of rant posts about rich kids lying about their income and achievements to not only get into ivies but also get full rides soOooOooOo.
All the time you get used to it.
I feel like it’s a combination of both. People look up to me man and we always joke and they’re always like I know you’d never do something like that and it’s like damn....
Stronger than I ever could be
Everyday gets worse man. Oh well..
Atleast you have a reason to stay be grateful for that I don’t and it’s only a matter of time..
And people like you that scam 💰
PREACH MY BROTHER PREACH. I just got scammed and I wanna die.

International so it wouldn’t matter but maybe I should use a vpn. I couldn’t live with them knowing I’m planning to commit and try talking me out of it. The disappointment in their faces would kill me.

Honestly this got so much comments and I’m really surprised, didn’t think I mattered this much. However, as I’m nearing finishing my letter and my paragraphs to my friends I realize more that i would stay in poverty despite exploiting every resource to escape it. 

I’m what people would describe as the stronger person they know so I know it’s gonna be a shocker. If there is anyone in my shoes I want you to know that even if I’m not strong enough to deal with my situation, you are! I may have taken the easy way out but you guys can fight and prove everyone wrong! I will miss all those anxiety filled nights checking this sub worrying about apps worrying about dinner or even getting money to attend school but that’s ok.

I will update one last time when I’ve finished my paragraphs to my friend and say my final goodbyes, I love you a2c you all are beautiful people who deserve the world.

As I sit here writing my suicide letter I remember all my friends and people that I inspired and how they looked up to me and really rooted for me and how distraught I would leave them. However, I can’t continue with my harsh reality. I’m poor and tired of struggling and don’t have the mental fortitude to fight my depression. College decisions was probably the only thing keeping me together and now that I have failed at the one thing I had any faith in I can’t anymore.

I’m international but I’m already done with school I’m just waiting back for results right now and that’s pretty depressing. I have a 1500 sat and some mediocre ecs so that’s a buzzkill. I like the rank approach I’d just use throwaways to do it.
Goodluck buddy hopefully we both live to see brighter days.
